messages:
michael: Heads-up: rolling out runtime 2.8.0 -> api 1.13.0 -> router 4.6 tonight. Window 02:30-03:30 UTC. Console migration must remain feature-flagged until router passthrough verified. Any preflight concerns?
adele: No infra blockers. One note: api 1.13.0 includes a header contract change (x-rdwd-context). We need strict gate for header consumers.
jeff: Sequence proposal: pin runtime, deploy runtime canary 5% for 8m, then api behind FF 5% for 10m, ramp 25% for 10m, then router. Console migration only after 15m stable post-router.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: runtime@2.8.0, api@1.13.0 (ff:header_context_v1), router@4.6. Scheduled 02:30 UTC. Preflight checks started. :robot_face:
infra-agent: Preflight: capacity OK, but two hosts report higher tail jitter. Recommend conservative canary ramps and keep concurrency lower on those hosts.
michael: Canary checks: p95 latency vs baseline and 5xx rate across api+router. Halt if p95 regresses >180ms or 5xx >1.5% for two consecutive 5m windows. Also track console/schema-errors (even though FF off).
adele: Add alert for api.header.parse.warn > 25/min — seen in staging if headers contain multiple contexts. Patch in 1.13.0 normalizes but keep watch.
jeff: Release notes draft to post after: "runtime: internal KV and eviction tuning; api: context header contract update (opt-in via FF); router: retry/backpressure smoothing; console: staged schema migration behind FF."
sara: I'll seed dashboards and enable 100% tracing for /v1/* during api canary (first 20m). Also add a synthetic hitting header-path with multiple headers to catch normalization regressions.
michael: Emergency playbook: if api canary trips, disable FF immediately and rollback api to 1.12.8; if runtime has node-level issues, unpin api/router and rollback runtime to 2.7.6. Keep rollback commands here.
deploy-bot: preflight results: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime and api; router smoke queued. Post-deploy hooks: migration-checker -> e2e-smoke. If migration-checker fails, auto-queue rollback.
adele: Rollback snippets for ops copy:
```
# rollback api to previous
deploy-bot rollback api@1.13.0 -> api@1.12.8
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:2.7.6
# unpin calls
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
```
jeff: Also: console FF name console.enable_context_migration. Do NOT flip until router shows header passthrough for 15m and console/schema-errors <0.2%.
sara: Pager duty: oncall set michael primary, adele secondary. I'll post minute-by-minute in this thread during the window.
michael: Kicking at 02:30 UTC. Keep all rollback signals in-thread and ping @adele for emergency unpin. Good luck.
